records.title: 10-K
records.text: •Applebee's reported system-wide sales grew 4.7% in 2022 driven by a 5.1% increase in domestic same-restaurant sales partially offset by an 1% decrease in domestic effective restaurants;

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The casual dining segment also experienced an increase in average customer check, partially offset by a decline in customer traffic.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The June 2022 issue of Nation's Restaurant News reported that IHOP was the largest restaurant system in the midscale full-service restaurant segment and Applebee's was the second largest restaurant system in the American full-service restaurant segment, in terms of United States system-wide sales during 2021.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The decrease in income before income taxes in fiscal 2022 compared to fiscal 2021 was due to higher G&A expenses including acquisition costs, partially offset by the increase in gross profit.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Cash provided by operating activities decreased $106.5 million in 2022 compared to 2021.
